prompt:
You are checking a raster-to-vector conversion. In the top row, picture A (left) is the original and picture B (right) is the vector copy drawn back to pixels. The bottom row shows the same small area of A and B enlarged. Judge only how faithful B is to A: shapes, colors, missing or extra parts, outlines, gradients, text. Ignore tiny anti-aliasing differences along edges.
Score 0-10: 10 = no visible difference; 8-9 = differences visible only in the enlarged area; 6-7 = small visible defects at normal size (a lost detail, a slightly wrong color in a small area); 3-5 = clear defects (missing shapes, merged colors, wrong gradients, holes); 0-2 = largely wrong.
Reply with JSON only: {"score": <integer 0-10>, "defects": ["short description", ...]} (an empty list if none).
